_comment: Learned mis-hear -> intended mappings for this room/mic. Keys are lowercased whisper output fragments, values are best-guess intent. Append as patterns are confirmed; see STT-MECHANISM.md for the (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) garble taxonomy.

before..note: seen 2x as a Book Game trivia-answer mismatch -- needs human confirmation before treating as confirmed

potato.note: deliberate second wake word, not a mishear -- this machine's own hostname, added 2026-07-23 per Zach

clot.note: 'the other clot' 2026-07-23 -- likely 'the other Claude', /klɔːd/ heard as /klɒt/, needs confirmation before treating as confirmed

clod.note: 'clod potato' 2026-07-23, same session as 'clot' above -- final-consonant devoicing/voicing wobbles on the same word both times (t vs d), strengthens the 'claude' hypothesis but still needs an explicit yes/no before calling it confirmed

wonder one.note: 'wonder one, please... switch to window' 2026-07-23 -- 'window' -> 'wonder' (d/n cluster reshuffle, dropped w-glide), self-disambiguated in the same breath by the literal word 'window' right after

gal wah.note: 'gal wah theory' 2026-07-23 -- whisper spelling-out the French pronunciation of 'Galois' phonetically since it has no English-spelling match; unconfirmed guess, not yet asked directly

cloud text.note: 'switch me to Windows 0 so I can see the cloud text' 2026-07-23 -- 'Claude' -> 'cloud', vowel-diphthong swap /klɔːd/ vs /klaʊd/, same word family as clot/clod above but a different vowel error this time; context (asking for window 0, the raw claude session) makes intent clear even if unconfirmed
